items.title: Structured Authority Injection: Persistent Human Control for LLM Agents via Typed MCP Overrides
items.summary: arXiv:2610.22373v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly used as autonomous orchestrators in distributed and multi-agent systems, yet a control gap remains: no protocol-level mechanism allows human operators to inject binding directives that persist across planning cycles. Free-text overrides suffer from ambiguous interpretation due to lack of schema validation and from authority erosion as operator instructions lose influence within accumulating context. We propose Stru
items.summary_zh: 提出结构化权限注入机制，通过类型化 MCP 覆盖实现跨规划周期持久化的人类控制，解决 LLM Agent 指令模糊问题。
items.why_zh: 涉及 Agent 控制协议设计，可复用 Typed Override 思路解决多 Agent 系统中人类干预的 schema 验证与状态持久化难题。

items.title: alkhder at ImageEval 2026 Shared Tasks: Constrained Selection and Rotation-Averaged Logit Scoring for Multimodal Hallucination Detection
items.summary: arXiv:2610.22515v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We describe our submission to Subtask~1b of ImageEval 2026. The task consists of selecting the single visually valid statement from three candidates paired with an image, and is in both English and Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). Our system uses a pre-trained 7B vision--language model in a zero-shot setting, without task-specific training or fine-tuning. We formulate the task as a constrained selection problem and choose the answer using next-token l
items.summary_zh: 团队利用预训练 7B VLM 零样本处理 ImageEval 2026 任务，通过约束选择和旋转平均 Logit 评分检测多模态幻觉。
items.why_zh: 掌握 VLM 零样本微调替代方案，学习 Logit 平均与约束解码技巧，适用于多模态幻觉评估场景。

items.title: TinyFish Makes Search Free: What It Really Costs an AI Agent to Read the Web
items.summary: An AI agent that reads the web pays 2 kinds of cost. The first is the retrieval charge: what a search or fetch API bills per request. The second is model processing: content passed from retrieved pages into an AI model consumes tokens, while reasoning and generated responses add further costs. TinyFish, a web infrastructure […] The post TinyFish Makes Search Free: What It Really Costs an AI Agent to Read the Web appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: TinyFish 揭示 AI 读网页的两类成本：检索费用与模型 token 消耗。
items.why_zh: 掌握评估 AI 代理成本的方法，可在系统设计中区分检索开销与推理开销，进行优化。

items.title: Managed Deep Agents explained in 2 minutes
items.summary: Managed Deep Agents (MDA) is the simplest way to build and deploy production agents. You focus on what your agent does, and MDA runs it. You write the agent’s intelligence: its instructions, the tools it can call, the skills it follows, and you select the model that drives it. MDA provides everything underneath: • The Deep Agents harness: The agent loop that plans, calls tools, manages a filesystem, and delegates to subagents. (Deep Agents explained in 1 minute: https://youtu.be/8gCam2-iGLc) • A…
items.summary_zh: Managed Deep Agents 提供托管的智能体运行平台，开发者只需编写指令、工具和技能。
items.why_zh: 学习如何将智能体逻辑与基础设施解耦，掌握托管式 Agent 平台的使用模式与可复用的工具调用模式。

items.title: Podium's Playbook for Scaling AI Agents Org-Wide
